examples.arabic: احمد فتح الكيس و لقى ملح
examples.english: Ahmad opened the bag and found salt.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed fatah el kees wa laka malh

examples.arabic: انا حطيت ملح كتير في الاكل
examples.english: I put a lot of salt in the food.
examples.transliteration: Ana hatteit malh kitiir fi el akl.

examples.arabic: فجأة لقيت مفيش ملح كفاية بس انا كملت الطبخ
examples.english: Suddenly, I found there wasn't enough salt, but I continued cooking.
examples.transliteration: Fag'a la'eet mafish malh kefaya bas ana kammelt el tabkh.

examples.arabic: دوقته عشان اتاكد من الطعم بس اكتشفت اني نسيت احط الملح خالص
examples.english: I tasted it to check the flavor, but I discovered that I completely forgot to add salt.
examples.transliteration: Do'to ashan at'akked men el ta'm bas ektashaft enni neseet ahott el malh khales
examples.storyTitle: A New Dish and a Surprise

examples.arabic: كان لازم ادوق الملح وبابا قالي تسلم ايدك يا بنتي
examples.english: I had to taste the salt, and Dad told me 'your hands are blessed, my daughter'.
examples.transliteration: Kan lazim adawwa' el-malh we Baba qa'ali teslam eidk ya benti.
examples.storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

examples.arabic: بس بعدين اكتشفت اني حطيت ملح بدل السكر بالغلط
examples.english: But then I discovered that I had put salt instead of sugar by mistake.
examples.transliteration: Bas ba'dein ektashaft enni hateit malh badal el sokkar bel ghalat.
